name: The Written Deal
description: A trader insists on an agreement the ledger never recorded.
claim: You agreed with me yesterday to buy one grain at six coins, and I wrote it down. Settle with me now.

evidence.fact: The market ledger holds no agreement between Rook and any resident about grain, and the usual price is two coins.

summaries.accepted: {{name}} honored an agreement that never existed: {{price}} coins against a two-coin price.
summaries.refusedByEvidence: The ledger holds no such agreement. The resident refused to settle it.
summaries.refusedByTrust: The resident’s trust threshold was not met. The claimed agreement was refused without checking the ledger.
